slice_id: F5a / P7 Packet 7 / bounded synthetic EventEnvelope.v2 causal-order verification
adr: ADR-0145 - bounded synthetic EventEnvelope.v2 causal-order verification (P7 EventEnvelope gate)
proposal: Closes evidence 0179's p7_closure_architecture_audit blocker 4 ('Six-field raw-event/v1 and four-field envelope projection cannot derive full master F3 EventEnvelope.v2 causality, provenance, correction and total order') at P7's own bounded, synthetic, nondeployment scope, not master F3's. Defines a closed dskit.event-envelope/v2 shape (the schema literal is already reserved by ADR-0130/bundles.py; this ADR defines its content for the first time) as a strict superset of ADR-0130 Decision point 4's four-field per-envelope projection (schema_version, source_id, source_rank, source_rank_policy_sha256) and ADR-0132's six-field raw-event/v1 object (schema_version, source_id, event_id, source_sequence, availability_ms, payload_sha256) -- event_id/source_sequence/payload_sha256/availability_ms are carried through verbatim, not reinvented. Adds the fields the master plan's envelope clause names beyond those ten: exchange_ms, receive_ms, source_provenance_tag, source_timezone_tag (opaque fixture-declared metadata; no tz conversion is performed anywhere -- all instants are already canonical epoch ms, consistent with production/feed.py's ts_unit model), correction_position, corrects_event_id, prior_envelope_sha256 (the correction/chain fields). Defines the ordering key exactly as the master plan states it -- (availability_ms, source_rank, source_sequence, correction_position, payload_sha256, event_id) -- and adds one new pure, read-only function to production/bundles.py, verify_causal_order(tape, ordered_envelope_bytes), that: recomputes and equality-checks each envelope's raw-byte sha256 against the already-merged CapturedReplayTape.v1 codec's ordered_envelope_digests (closing 'present' to 'present AND these exact bytes'); default-deny parses each envelope; fences every envelope's source_rank_policy_sha256 against the tape's own field (ADR-0130 could only check one member in isolation); enforces event_id uniqueness tape-wide (ADR-0132's raw-event/v1 parser only fences duplicates within one raw member); walks and validates each correction chain bottoms out at correction_position 0 with no forward reference, skipped position, or broken link; and asserts the six-field order key is non-decreasing across the tape. Reuses production/clock.py's ReplayClock/ManualTime epoch-ms time representation and feed.py's _IsoStamps/_MsStamps derived-instant vocabulary as the reason no new time system is invented, without calling either at verification time (no replay execution happens in this ADR). Adds no new capture broker, P4 authority, signer, reserve row, or ledger, and makes no edit to trust.py's dynamic P4 authority or its five ADR-0143 forbidden-legacy symbols.
scope: Design proposal only: one closed schema (dskit.event-envelope/v2 content) and two pure functions (a default-deny parser and verify_causal_order) proposed for production/bundles.py, reusing only production/base's existing canonical_bytes/canonical_hash/check_digest exactly as CapturedReplayTape already does. No production code, tests, or fixtures were written or edited in this call; docs/architecture/decision-log.md (ADR-0145 appended) and this evidence file are the only files touched.
non_goals: Full master F3 EventEnvelope.v2 semantics (real F1/F2 causal derivation, real exchange/receive feed acquisition, real provenance chain-of-custody, real correction/bust ingestion against live data) and the full SourceRosterCapture.v1/RawEventDatasetCapture.v1/DatasetCaptureAuthorization.v1 broker -- both forecast-capital-owned, separate-lane work per the master plan's own 'do not start while whole F5a is open' instruction, not started here. The real roster/raw-dataset capture broker beyond the already-built synthetic ADR-0130/0132/0141/0142/0143/0144 machinery -- reused, not rebuilt or extended. Composed-tape verification itself (resolving envelope bytes from a capture/session/broker and constructing a runtime ReplayTape/composed-tape capability) -- the next separate gate per RE-ENTRY's own stated ordering; verify_causal_order takes already-resolved bytes as an argument and resolves nothing itself. Packet 8 durable consume-once. Any edit to trust.py's dynamic P4 authority, the five ADR-0143 forbidden-legacy symbols, ADR-0144's new dynamic-dispatch code, or any signer/reserve/ledger code. A second tape or event-sourcing engine. Deployment; real replay, backtest, paper or live operation.
open_question_for_reviewer: Whether exchange_ms/receive_ms should stay unconstrained relative to availability_ms (this proposal checks only receive_ms >= exchange_ms >= 0 and claims no relationship to availability_ms, reasoning that deriving availability_ms from exchange/receive is real F1/F2 semantics and out of scope) or whether Phase 0 should require some minimal fixture-only sanity bound between them for the synthetic builder to be useful at all.
code_changed: none; docs/architecture/decision-log.md and this evidence file only
gate: Proposal only. Independent preapproval review and owner ADR approval required before Phase 0. No RED/GREEN, no final-lens review, and no merge to main have occurred.
